title: timezonerule
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, timezonedefinitionid.

bias.description: Base time bias of the time zone rule.

createdon.description: Date and time when the time zone rule was created.

daylightbias.description: Time bias in addition to the base bias for daylight savings time.

daylightday.description: Day of the month when daylight savings time starts.

daylightdayofweek.description: Day of the week when daylight savings time starts.

daylighthour.description: Hour of the day when daylight savings time starts

daylightminute.description: Minute of the hour when daylight savings time starts.

daylightmonth.description: Month when daylight savings time starts.

daylightsecond.description: Second of the minute when daylight savings time starts

daylightyear.description: Year when daylight savings times starts.

effectivedatetime.description: Time that this rule takes effect, in local time.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the time zone rule was modified.

standardbias.description: Time bias in addition to the base bias for standard time.

standardday.description: Day of the month when standard time starts.

standarddayofweek.description: Day of the week when standard time starts.

standardhour.description: Hour of the day when standard time starts.

standardminute.description: Minute of the hour when standard time starts.

standardsecond.description: Second of the Minute when standard time starts.

timezoneruleid.description: Unique identifier of the time zone rule.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the time zone rule.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the timezonerule.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the time zone rule.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the timezonerule.

_timezonedefinitionid_value.description: Unique identifier of the time zone definition.
